items.title: HPC architecture and consulting
items.body: Independent review and design input for clusters: compute, scheduling, storage, networking and the datacentre constraints that shape them.

items.title: Research computing infrastructure
items.body: Planning and operating shared platforms for researchers, including capacity planning, hardware lifecycle and procurement support.

items.title: Slurm deployment and optimisation
items.body: Scheduler design for multi-user research environments: partitions, accounting, fair-share and GPU scheduling.

items.title: Storage architecture
items.body: Ceph and Lustre design choices for research workloads, and how they fit the network and the budget.

items.title: Linux systems engineering
items.body: RHEL-family builds, hardening, identity integration and day-two operations, handled as code.

items.title: OpenStack infrastructure
items.body: Private cloud design and deployment with Kayobe, including network architecture.

items.title: High-performance networking
items.body: Datacentre fabric design for HPC and AI workloads: high-speed Ethernet, RoCE, BGP and IPv6.

items.title: Infrastructure automation
items.body: Ansible, Terraform and Git-based CI/CD so that infrastructure is repeatable, reviewed and documented.

items.title: Linux training and workshops
items.body: Hands-on teaching for teams, built on the same labs I publish openly: RHCSA preparation, server hardening and administration.

items.title: Technical consulting
items.body: A second opinion on an architecture, a procurement decision or an operating model, written up clearly.
